# algosec_network_objects (Data Source)

Matching network objects from the documented paginated search. Reads all pages, bounded at 1000 pages of 100. Fails on duplicate IDs, inconsistent metadata or incomplete results. Query may be empty.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algosec_network_objects" "example" {
  device_name = "ExampleDevice"
  query       = ""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_name` (String) Device name.
- `query` (String) Search text; an empty string matches all objects.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Lookup identity.
- `objects` (Attributes List) Complete returned inventory, deterministically ordered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `canonized_name` (String) Canonized name.
- `id` (Number) Id.
- `ip_address` (String) Ip address.
- `ip_type` (String) Ip type.
- `members` (String) Members.
- `original_name` (String) Original name.
- `zone` (String) Zone.
